channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: mixed (+0.6).

item.title: [+1] September exports jump 23% to $44.4 billion; goods trade deficit at $30.21 billion
item.description:
Imports rose to $74.61 billion. The deficit narrowed from $33 billion a year ago but widened from $26.86 billion in August, in line with the $30.4 billion forecast. With services, the deficit was $13.3 billion. Exports rose 18.5% in April–September.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering and electronics exports up

Why it matters: Strong exports of electronics, engineering goods, petroleum products and chemicals support growth and dollar inflows, but oil-driven imports keep the deficit high and the rupee under pressure.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] US to decide within days on Russian oil tariffs that could hit India; sanctions law deadline nears
item.description:
India awaits a relief decision ahead of the US Secretary of State's visit. Analysts warn tariff risk puts India's exports under pressure. Escalating.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Export tariff risk

Why it matters: Penalty tariffs over Russian oil would hit Indian exports to the US and force costlier crude sourcing, hurting growth and the rupee.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
